			OR = {

				location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_ancestor_shrine value >= 5 }
				location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_quiet_land value >= 5 }
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			any_owned_location = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_dynastic_necropolis value >= 6 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_ancestor_shrine value >= 6 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_quiet_land value >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	pop_join_rebel_threshold = -0.125
	pop_leave_rebels_threshold = -0.125
	monthly_towards_traditionalist = 0.25
}

	potential_trigger = {
		any_owned_location = {
			OR = {
				location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_muster_wall value >= 1 }
				location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_signal_fires_wall value >= 1 }
				location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_wall_oath value >= 1 }
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			any_owned_location = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_muster_wall value >= 2 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_signal_fires_wall value >= 2 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_wall_oath value >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	monthly_towards_defensive = 0.05
}
